answer: Sybil resistance by conviction voting. Vote weight is stake times time held, squared; any transfer resets the timer. A farm splitting one purse into a thousand keys gives every key a zero clock - a thousand clones hold near-zero conviction while one honest holder's long-sitting saffron outweighs them all. Public funding roots expose cloned lineages as a pigment of synchronized resets. To matter tomorrow, an attacker must hold today - the one cost sybils cannot bear, capital idle in a opal while honest peers compound.
